messages:
maria: Heads-up — starting FastQuant canary for the model-bridge this afternoon. Need curation + label ops to prioritize long-code, dialogue, and deid edgecases. I will push a 120-sample set to queue 2234 (tag: canary=fastquant). cc @sam @cheng

sam: Got it. What's the sampling query? Can we constrain tokens > 300 and contains_code=true?

maria: Quick sample SQL I used to export the pool:
```sql
SELECT * FROM prompt_pool
WHERE model_compat = 'v2' AND tokens > 300
  AND contains_code = true
ORDER BY random()
LIMIT 120
```
Will tag metadata: canary=fastquant, priority=high, label_schema=golden-v2

cheng: FYI FastQuant has rerank instability with long code blocks + trailing backticks. Include parity-control prompts (N=5 rerank) and a small FP32 baseline subset for side-by-side diffs.

alex: Label ops: we can take 120 but earliest start is in ~2 hours. Recommend microbatches of 30 and mark hallucination checks as priority. Also need deid review for PII candidates.

labeler-bot: queue 2234 created. Microbatches: [30,30,30,30]. SLA requested: 48h. Guideline: lab-guide/fastquant-v2.3 (link posted to ops channel).

julie: Also adding 20 prompts from the current golden that exercise tokenization edgecases (emoji, ZWJ, RTL) so we can surface tokenizer drift. I'll add them to the holdout manifest.

sam: How are we measuring regressions? Proposal: embed_cosine, BLEU/ROUGE, plus a binary hallucination flag. Add human helpfulness rubric (1-3). Automate diff thresholds -> alert if breached.

maria: Agreed. Canary acceptance criteria (draft):
- hallucination delta > 8% vs FP32 => fail
- embed sim < 0.92 for >10% samples => fail
- median latency increase > 1.3x => investigate
Run: 50k tokens sample on both FP32 baseline and FastQuant. Scripts: infra/ops/fastquant/canary-run.sh

cheng: Ping @ops-bot to reserve a GPU with quant profile int4-fast and to ensure KV cache memory checks.

ops-bot: Reserving rtx-a5000-1 for 3h window starting 6623460000. Alerts routed to #eng-ml-incidents. Will post reservation id in the infra channel.

alex: Note — sample pool was generated with tokenizer v2.1. FastQuant inference uses heuristic token merges; add token-count mapping check in the eval so tokenization drift doesn't bias metrics. Julie, can you add that to QA?

julie: Will add a token-diff check column to the QA sheet and update golden manifest: +20 token-edgecases, +120 canary samples, holdout bump +10%. Sheet: https://redwood.sheets/fastquant-canary (internal).

sam: I'll wire up the eval job to compute per-sample diffs and produce a CI-friendly report (json + csv). Will post the first microbatch summary once labelers finish.

maria: Timeline: sample export now, labeling starts in ~2h, first microbatch eval by EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:
